pr_title: [Merged by Bors] - Fix spawning empty bundles
pr_body:
# Objective

Alternative to #6424 
Fixes #6226

Fixes spawning empty bundles

## Solution

Add `BundleComponentStatus` trait and implement it for `AddBundle` and a new `SpawnBundleStatus` type (which always returns an Added status). `write_components` is now generic on `BundleComponentStatus` instead of taking `AddBundle` directly. This means BundleSpawner can now avoid needing AddBundle from the Empty archetype, which means BundleSpawner no longer needs a reference to the original archetype.

In theory this cuts down on the work done in `write_components` when spawning, but I'm seeing no change in the spawn benchmarks.

issue_context.title: `World.spawn(())` panics with index out of bounds
issue_context.body:
> `world.spawn(())` seems to panic with "index out of bounds: the len is 0 but the index is 0". But `commands.spawn(())` seems fine.

_Originally posted by @Zeenobit in https://github.com/bevyengine/bevy/issues/6186#issuecomment-1273856220_

This bug was introduced with @cart's #6054. I think it's important that we fix this for 0.9 to avoid introducing nasty crashes in people's code.
comments: while carts PR _does_ introduce this, `get_bundle_spawner` seems to just have been wrong since it was introduced, `cmds.spawn_bundle(())` does `.spawn().insert(())` internally which uses `get_bundle_inserter` which _isnt_ buggy

`BundleSpawner` currently holds a reference to an `AddBundle` and also `&mut` to the `Archetype` so something has to change here in order to make this work. tangentially: `BundleInserter` has a `// PERF` fixme about storing an `&AddBundle` along side the `&mut Archetype` which is funny considering that is exactly the problem here

review_comments: The relationship between `T` and `S` is hard to follow here. I'm unsure about whether this should be documented on this method, BundleComponentStatus, or both.
I've added clarifying docs on the requirements and behavior here.
Basic docs here to help explain how this new trait is being used?
I'm slightly confused by this comment. This is just making an existing internal enum Copy/Clone.
I'm guessing you meant this comment to be on BundleComponentStatus. I've added clarifying documentation to the behavior and role of this trait.

```suggestion
       // Components added during a spawn_bundle call are always treated as added
        ComponentStatus::Added
```
Good call! I applied this manually as the indentation was off in this suggestion.
